{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.18

|arg= global

|gr1= Object Manipulation

|descr= Gets the angular velocity of the object in model space as a 3D vector. The units are in Rad/s (radians per second) and rotations are clockwise.

|s1= [[angularVelocityModelSpace]] obj

|p1= obj: [[Object]] 

|r1= [[Vector3D]] - angular velocity of the object in model space ([0,0,0] if angular velocity is not supported by the object)

|x1= <sqf>hint str angularVelocityModelSpace myHeli; // [0.01, 0.03, 0.95]</sqf>

|seealso= [[velocityModelSpace]] [[setAngularVelocityModelSpace]] [[angularVelocity]]
}}
